text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Colombian President Ernesto Samper expected on a two-day work visit to Morocco starting Thursday.
- National commission in charge of monitoring elections holds first meeting.
- According to a survey carried by a research centre 10 percent of urban population is socially marginalised.
- Jobless graduates pursue sit-in to press for jobs.
- The state sold majority stakes in oil refinery Samir and Societe Cherifienne des Petroles to Saudi Corral Petroleum Holding AB.
- King Hassan congratulates Tony Blair following his Labour Party's crushing victory in the British general elections.
- King Hassan sends condolence message to Egyptian Hosni Mubarak over victims of sand storm in Cairo.
- State-owned utility Office national des Chemins de Fer ONCF to raise cost of tickets between Casablanca and Rabat.
- Fouad Filali, head of ONA group, says Moroccan tourism can generate more jobs but it needs better management.
